title: Decide FA depreciation request-page options or guarded controlled repeat
purpose: Choose the next safe route after Calculate Depreciation OK was executed once but FADEP-291-OK remains invisible in the read-only Fixed Asset G/L Journals trace.

decisionOptions.description: Inspect existing Calculate Depreciation request-page evidence and decide whether a missing option, filter or target batch explains the absent journal line.
Run Calculate Depreciation again only with a new unique document number and explicit duplicate-line safeguards, then search the journal immediately.
Treat depreciation posting as labor-blocked and shift to another high-value process until German final rebuild or better BC route exists.

expectedOutputs: A compact decision JSON/Markdown explaining whether the next step is request-page review, guarded controlled repeat, or parking.
If controlled repeat is selected, it must use a fresh document number and no Preview/Post until the resulting journal line is visible.
targetGermanCompanyImpact: The German target company must reproduce the depreciation route from request page through journal line, Preview Posting and posted FA/G/L entries.
nextStep: Decide whether to review request-page options locally or run a guarded controlled repeat with a fresh document number; do not repeat FADEP-291-OK.
